preservedFailures.reason: EV-PLAT-001 admitted all required supporting Claims but the final fixed-budget pass evicted the selected Wiki body. The G3 contract was strengthened to require the affected module itself to remain visible.

questions.causalTrace: R0 retrieved only the broad test-passed Claim and unrelated build-manifest governance, while W2 exposed the frozen module plus its exact approval, coverage, vulnerability, rollback/monitor and 24/7 release supporting Claims. The answer improvement therefore matches the preregistered treatment.

provenMechanisms: A multi-assertion Wiki module can remain evidence-closed while one superseded assertion is replaced locally and unrelated assertions retain their identity.
A real SUPERSEDES transaction discovered and rebuilt all 3 affected modules, quarantined prior copies, preserved stable addresses and left all 3 control modules byte-stable.
Under the same 6000 estimated-token budget and retrieval base, W2 kept the selected module and all required supporting Claims visible for every affected question.
On the six-question development pilot, W2 converted its unique offline coverage advantage on EV-PLAT-001 into explicit answer coverage without harming the five paired controls.
notProven: The modules were manually frozen from known development Claims; M2 does not prove automatic Wiki formation or module-boundary discovery.
Five of six question pairs tied. One development-question improvement is causal mechanism evidence, not a general product-effect estimate.
M2 does not prove held-out generalization, long-horizon memory value, large-corpus Graph value, or production cost efficiency.
M2 does not justify question-, domain- or Gold-specific production branches.

nextMilestone.name: 盲持出 Wiki 形成与消费验证
nextMilestone.primaryQuestion: Can the system form evidence-closed multi-assertion Wiki modules without access to held-out questions or Gold, then preserve M2's correction and coverage benefits on unseen source clusters?
nextMilestone.requiredSeparation: Formation may read only frozen Stage A sources and canonical knowledge. Stage B questions and Gold remain sealed until modules, packs, answers and hashes are frozen.
nextMilestone.stopRule: Do not claim general product uplift or expand production defaults unless H1 reproduces faithful coverage gains without hard regressions and within the preregistered budget.
